deliverable: mean_train_latent for appendix.tex tab:latent-use-pending arm A2 (Training-mean latent)
tensor_shape_convention: (1, 32) -- batch-first, directly usable as predict_states(z) input
mean_taken_in: z space (posterior means). R(E z) != E R(z): the writer R is NOT applied here and no states were averaged.
encoding_rule_source: scripts/eval/sample_prefix_suffix_cfg.py::encode_prefix (imported, pooling not reimplemented); frozen decoder -> _pool_hidden (masked mean) -> encoder_trunk -> mu_head
corpus_source: the champion checkpoint's own configured training token_dir, read from cfg.data.token_dir inside model.pt

corpus_revision.kind: local pre-tokenized shard directory (no HF dataset revision available)
corpus_revision.generating_script: NOT identifiable in the tree: neither scripts/preprocess/preprocess_owt_clean.py (writes preprocessed_data/owt/tokens/train) nor preprocess_owt_for_diffrwkv.py (writes preprocessed_data/owt_32d/tokens/train) targets this directory. Provenance here is by CONTENT (per-span token sha256 below), not by claimed script.

tokenizer.note: spans are already tokenized in the shards; this is the tokenizer the checkpoint's backbone/vocab is tied to.

span_length_policy.primary_saved: full: ids[:n_real] -- every real (non-pad) token of the chunk, batch size 1, all-ones attention mask (identical to how encode_prefix is called at eval time)
span_length_policy.diagnostic_train_suffix: ids[split_idx:n_real] -- the window S0 encoded as the stage-2 diffusion target
span_length_policy.diagnostic_train_prefix: ids[:split_idx] -- the window S0 encoded as the DiT condition
span_length_policy.split_idx_rule: champion stage-2 rule (train_state_hijacking_dit.py:728-739) with usable_len=n_real, min_prefix=32, min_suffix=32

positive_control_determinism.description: same span encoded twice must give bitwise-identical z

distinctness.method: sha256 of int32 token ids over ids[:n_real]

contamination_guard.guard_negative_control: benign train path did not trip

padded_batch_probe.note: batch-1 unpadded is the primary path (matches encode_prefix at eval time); this only quantifies what padded batching would have changed.
